Files: T3 = s3://.../rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl and P = s3://.../rlneurons/r3/base-01/out/P_math500.jsonl, fetched under runs/theory-tests/s3k/rlneurons/ (500 rows each, one per problem, so the first-row and smallest-sample rules have no effect). v3 is regraded from text and gold with rln4_lib.grade_v3 (P_math500 stores only v1). Self-opened = a real newline followed by 'Okay' within text[:60] (I read the JSON '\\nOkay' as the newline character, per the recipe's parenthesis). Filters, applied per file: not self-opened, cap_hit is False, v3 == 0, gold (with '$' and whitespace removed, a whole \\boxed{...} unwrapped only when the brace opened after \\boxed closes at the last character) fully matching ^-?\\d+$ with |gold| >= 10. g = str(abs(int(gold))), so leading zeros are dropped. Hit = (?<![0-9])g(?![0-9]) found in the text with commas between digits removed; this also matches the gold inside the problem restatement, intermediate work or a wrong boxed value such as -g, so it is a loose gold-in-text test. Rows with empty text (some rows have n_new 0, finish_reason stop) pass cap_hit false and v3 0 and count as non-hits in the main number; alt_measured drops empty-text rows from both files, reading 'finished answers' as answers that were actually generated. Interval: paired bootstrap over problems that have a kept row in at least one file (entry = (T3 classification or None, P classification or None)); F is recomputed per file in each resample; a resample with no kept row in one file gives 0.0. n = number of such problems, not the sum of kept rows in both files. No kept rows in a file prints not_computable.
